seoTitle: robots.txt Templates for WordPress, Shopify and Magento
metaDescription: Starting-point robots.txt files for WordPress, WooCommerce, Shopify, Magento, static sites, staging and AI-crawler opt-out. Free, copy and edit.
intro: Pick a platform and get a sensible starting robots.txt with comments explaining why.
why:
Most sites need the same few rules: keep admin, cart, internal search and parameter URLs out of the crawl, and point to the sitemap. Starting from a template is faster than from a blank file.

These templates are generic starting points, not vendor defaults (Shopify, for example, generates its own file). Edit them, then validate and test before publishing.
howTo: Copy the result and adapt paths to your site.

faq.q: Are these the platforms' official files?
faq.a: No. They are common practice. WordPress and Shopify generate their own files, and the notes say so.

faq.q: Will the staging template remove my pages from Google?
faq.a: No. Blocking crawling does not remove indexed URLs; use noindex or a password.
That is your choice. The AI template covers common training crawlers; see the directory for details.

faq.q: Do I need robots.txt at all?
faq.a: No, but a missing file returns a 404 on every request, and a simple file avoids that.
